name: Jumachuu
source:
Thrown out for being useless and a disappointment, it now follows Yumemi, [Spoiler] his mother,[/spoiler] wherever she may go. 

[Spoiler]His favorite foods, or rather drinks, are orange juice and female juices.[/spoiler]
